query: Which SRMs, blank and replicate frequencies, and LA-ICP-MS spot-selection strategies (spot size, prill vs matrix) are best practice for slag and prill geochemical analysis?

response.query: Which SRMs, blank and replicate frequencies, and LA-ICP-MS spot-selection strategies (spot size, prill vs matrix) are best practice for slag and prill geochemical analysis?
response.answer: For slag and prill geochemical analysis, use SRM NIST 2818, blank every 10 samples, replicate every 20, and LA-ICP-MS with 40-60 µm spot size, focusing on prill vs matrix.
